description: Returns the API key details for the specified service account.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: The unique identifier for the user within the account.

user_id.description: The unique identifier for the user within the Fivetran system.

user_type.description: The type of user. Possible values: `REGULAR_USER`: A human user who can log in to the Fivetran dashboard and interact with the API, and `SERVICE_ACCOUNT`: A non-human identity for machine-to-machine API access that cannot log in to the dashboard.

key_value.description: The public identifier of the API key.

created_at.description: The timestamp that the user created their API key

key_status.description: The status of the API key. Possible values: `ACTIVE`: The key has a single active secret, `ACTIVE_GRACE`:  The key has two active secrets during rotation overlap, and `EXPIRED`: The key has expired.

expires_at.description: The timestamp when the API key expires.

overlap_expires_at.description: The timestamp when the previous secret expires after rotation. Only present during the overlap period.
